annotations.title: Is this service working now, and since when (signed)

description: Is a service your agent depends on working right now, and since when? Signed, dated readings for 30 services: model APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral, Groq, Cohere...), clouds (AWS regions, Azure, Google Cloud, Cloudflare...), mail and messaging, payments (Stripe, Coinbase, Base) and agent rails (x402 facilitator, MCP Registry). Each reading joins the provider's own status feed with our own timed request, by a published rule, and says since when the state has held. Send {} for all, or services (ids) or group. Free; nothing you send is stored.

history_hours.description: State changes to list per service, looking back this many hours (default 24).

services.description: Service ids. Leave out for every service.
